sketch.name: CrushMarginGauge
sketch.description: An ethanol crush margin widget: today's margin in $/gal with its change, a trend line inside its high-low band, and the breakdown of revenues (ethanol, DDGS, corn oil) against costs (corn, natural gas).

props.name: change
props.description: Change in the margin since the previous close.

props.name: range
props.description: How many days of history the trend shows.

props.name: showBreakdown
props.description: Shows the revenue and cost breakdown under the trend.

props.name: positiveColor
props.description: Colour of revenues and a rising margin; the theme's when empty.

props.name: negativeColor
props.description: Colour of costs and a falling margin; the theme's when empty.

props.name: history
props.description: Daily margins, oldest first: { date, value }.

props.name: breakdown
props.description: What makes up the margin, in $/gal: revenues positive, costs negative: { name, value }.

sketch.notes: Simple control (no items or collections): history and breakdown are data rows. Trend drawn as SVG in an Html embed. Colours follow the GridKrafter palette (same tokens as GridBoard/StatTile). Margin = ethanol + DDGS + corn oil − corn − natural gas, per gallon. Meant to sit in a GridBoard card about 5 columns × 5 rows.
